issues.title: Bottom container clipping
issues.description: The payload inspector extends beyond the bottom edge, clipping the container border and code content.
issues.evidence: The lower border of the payload container is truncated at the bottom of the viewport.
issues.suggestion: Reduce vertical padding or row height across the page so the full inspector fits without overflow.
issues.triageNote: Real: with maxHeightClass=max-h-[104px] the body clips mid-line (scrollHeight 216 vs clientHeight 104) with zero scroll affordance — added a fade mask + centered expand control (click toggles full payload); container-border-at-viewport-edge portion is page height (eval page off-limits). Also pinned the syntax/border palette to literals: DS neutrals invert in dark theme and rendered numbers invisible + glaring border on the fixed near-black surface.

issues.title: Corrupted RTL code formatting
issues.description: Code content inherits RTL direction, causing right-aligned code, misplaced punctuation, and inverted syntax.
issues.evidence: JSON brackets, commas, and wrapped strings are right-aligned and disorganized inside the payload box.
issues.suggestion: Enforce dir="ltr" and left text alignment on the code container.
issues.triageNote: Real: the <pre> body inherited dir=rtl from EvalShell so JSON brackets/commas/indentation bidi-reordered — isolated the code body with dir=ltr + text-start (same pattern as ds:QueryInput).
